12-Day Greek Island Hopping: Mykonos, Paros & Santorini
summary:
The 12-Day Greece Island Hopping Holiday gives each stop more time, combining Athens with three Cycladic islands rather than moving on after only a night or two. Begin with the Acropolis and historic Athens, then travel across the Aegean to Mykonos, Paros and Santorini. Mykonos brings lively island towns and beaches, Paros offers a more relaxed pace, while Santorini closes the journey around its volcanic caldera and distinctive villages.
Travel is planned from April to October around seasonal ferry schedules. The holiday covers selected 4-star hotels with breakfast, English-speaking local guides for scheduled visits, speed ferry tickets, plus airport and port transfers between each stage of the journey.

itinerary.title: Arrival in Athens
itinerary.text:
Arrival at Athens International Airport. Meet and transfer to your hotel.
Check-in after 14:00. The remainder of the day is at leisure. Overnight in Athens.

itinerary.title: Half Day Morning Athens City tour
itinerary.text:
Breakfast at the hotel.
Enjoy a half-day guided tour of Athens, including the Acropolis of Athens, Acropolis Museum, and Parthenon. Continue past the Parliament, Tomb of the Unknown Soldier, Presidential Palace, Panathenaic Stadium, Temple of Olympian Zeus, and Arch of Hadrian. Afternoon at leisure. Overnight in Athens.

itinerary.title: Ferry to Mykonos
itinerary.text:
Breakfast and check-out from the hotel.
Transfer to the port for your Seajet ferry to Mykonos.
Arrival and transfer to your hotel. Rest of the day at leisure. Overnight in Mykonos.
Optional: Domestic flights to Mykonos are available upon request.

itinerary.title: Free day in Mykonos
itinerary.text:
Breakfast at the hotel.
Free day in Mykonos. Relax on the island’s beautiful beaches or explore Mykonos Town.
Optional visit to Delos, one of Greece’s most important archaeological islands.
Enjoy Mykonos’ famous nightlife in the evening. Overnight in Mykonos.

itinerary.title: Free day in Mykonos
itinerary.text:
Breakfast at the hotel.
Enjoy a free day in Mykonos to explore Mykonos Town, relax on the beaches, or discover different parts of the island. In the evening, experience the island’s famous nightlife. Overnight in Mykonos.

itinerary.title: Ferry to Paros
itinerary.text:
Breakfast and check-out from the hotel. Transfer to the port for your ferry to Paros.
Arrival and transfer to your hotel. Rest of the day at leisure. Overnight in Paros.

itinerary.title: Free day in Paros
itinerary.text:
Breakfast at the hotel.
Enjoy a free day in Paros with time to relax on beautiful beaches, enjoy watersports and hiking trails, or explore the island’s traditional whitewashed villages. In the evening, relax and enjoy dinner at a local Greek restaurant. Overnight in Paros.

itinerary.title: Ferry to Santorini
itinerary.text:
Breakfast and check-out from the hotel. Transfer to the port for your ferry to Santorini.
Arrival and transfer to your hotel. Rest of the day at leisure. Overnight in Santorini.

itinerary.title: Free day in Santorini
itinerary.text:
Breakfast at the hotel. Enjoy a free day in Santorini to relax on the island’s famous black, red, or golden sand beaches.
Explore Fira or join optional boat and volcano excursions available on the island. Overnight in Santorini.

itinerary.title: Free day in Santorini
itinerary.text: Breakfast at the hotel. Enjoy a free day in Santorini. Explore the villages of Fira and Oia, known for their scenic views, local shops, and cliffside cafés. Relax on Santorini’s famous black, red, and golden sand beaches. Optional tours and excursions are available upon request. Overnight in Santorini.

itinerary.title: Ferry to Athens
itinerary.text:
Breakfast and check-out from the hotel. Free time at leisure until transfer to the port.
Depart by Seajet ferry to Athens. Upon arrival, transfer to your hotel. Overnight in Athens.

itinerary.title: Departure from Athens
itinerary.text:
After breakfast, check out from the hotel before 12:00 pm.
Transfer to Athens Airport according to your flight departure time.

faqs.q: What destinations are included in the 12-Day Greece Island Hopping Holiday?
faqs.a: The 12-Day Greece Island Hopping Holiday covers Athens, Mykonos, Paros, and Santorini. You will explore Athens' ancient landmarks, enjoy the cosmopolitan atmosphere of Mykonos, discover the authentic Cycladic charm of Paros, and experience Santorini's breathtaking caldera views and famous sunsets. The tour runs for 11 nights and 12 days.

faqs.q: How much does the 12-Day Greece Island Hopping Holiday cost?
faqs.a: The tour starts from €2,595 per person for the 2026 season. The price includes accommodation, domestic speed ferry tickets, guided sightseeing tours, selected meals, and all airport, hotel, and port transfers specified in the itinerary. Final pricing may vary depending on travel dates and hotel availability.

faqs.q: Are ferry tickets included in this Greece island-hopping itinerary?
faqs.a: Yes, all required domestic speed ferry tickets between Athens, Mykonos, Paros, and Santorini are included. These ferry journeys offer a comfortable and scenic way to travel between the beautiful Cycladic Islands.

faqs.q: Are international flights included in the package?
faqs.a: No, international flights are not included in the tour price. Travelers are responsible for arranging their own flights to and from Greece. Magnificent Travel can assist with itinerary planning and travel recommendations if needed.

faqs.q: Does the 12-day Greece Island Hopping Holiday include a guide?
faqs.a: Yes, professional English-speaking guides are included during the scheduled sightseeing tours. Your guides provide historical insights, cultural information, and local expertise while helping you discover Greece's most famous destinations.

faqs.q: Is this tour suitable for first-time visitors to Greece?
faqs.a: Yes, this tour is ideal for first-time visitors who want to experience Greece's most iconic islands. It combines the historical treasures of Athens with three of the most beautiful islands in the Cyclades, creating a perfect balance of culture, sightseeing, and relaxation.

faqs.q: How fit do I need to be for the tour?
faqs.a: The physical difficulty is easy to moderate. Travelers should be comfortable walking through historic districts, island villages, ferry ports, and areas with steps and uneven surfaces. Most travelers in average health can comfortably participate.

faqs.q: What are the highlights of Mykonos, Paros, and Santorini?
faqs.a: Mykonos is famous for its charming old town, windmills, beaches, and vibrant atmosphere. Paros offers traditional villages, beautiful beaches, and a more relaxed island experience. Santorini is renowned for its dramatic caldera views, whitewashed architecture, blue-domed churches, and unforgettable sunsets.

faqs.q: What is the cancellation policy for the Greece Island Hopping Holiday?
faqs.a: You can cancel free of charge up to 30 days before the tour departure date. Cancellations made within 30 days may be subject to fees according to the booking terms, ferry conditions, and cancellation policy. Travel insurance is recommended for additional flexibility and protection.

faqs.q: Is the 12-Day Greece Island Hopping Holiday available all year and can it be customized?
faqs.a: The tour operates throughout the year, subject to seasonal ferry schedules. You can extend your stay in Athens or any of the islands, upgrade hotel categories, add optional excursions, or modify the itinerary according to your preferences. Contact Magnificent Travel for a personalized itinerary and quotation.
